title: Advancement_dp
description: Brand new successes for Minecraft (added regularly)
body:
# **_🟢 ROOT_**


MineAdvancement — Have dirt or a log in your inventory.

Branch 1 — Mining

Fire ?! — Craft a Furnace.

Harder than stone — Smelt raw iron into an iron ingot.

Like a Golem — Craft a full iron armor set (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots).

In the deeper — Reach Y level 0 or below (deep caves).

Ore Collector ⭐ — Collect all ores: coal, copper (or raw), iron (or raw), gold (or raw), redstone, lapis, and diamond.

Main Upgrade ⭐ — Craft a full diamond armor set.

So long.. — Get obsidian in your inventory.

Iron... No... — Get quartz in your inventory.

No !!! 🔴 — Break a full netherite gear set (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots, axe, pickaxe, shovel, hoe, spear — all at 0 durability).

Upgrade again?! ⭐ — Get a Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template.

Indestructible soldier — Upgrade a full armor set to netherite at the smithing table.

# **Branch 2 — Engineer (from Ore Collector)**

Engineer — Craft a Redstone Block.

The Power — Craft a Lever.

Everything Necessary — Have a Dispenser, a Piston or Sticky Piston, and an Observer in your inventory.

# **Branch 3 — Enchanting (from Ore Collector)**

Enchanter — Craft a Lapis Block.

Magical Power — Craft an Enchanting Table.

Shakespeare — Get a Bookshelf in your inventory.

Mega Power — Enchant any item at level 30.

# **Branch 4 — Side advancements**

Protection — Craft a Shield. (from iron)

Teleportation — Use an Ender Eye. (from obsidian)



For now there is only 1 success page, but more are coming
